content: Within six months, Sabrina will engage in a catching game by catching a medium-sized ball with two hands in 4 out of 5 opportunities, with minimal assistance, enhancing bilateral coordination and gross motor control.

Within three months, Sabrina will demonstrate the ability to navigate stairs with alternating feet using a handrail in 4 out of 5 attempts during play activities, with minimal cues, to improve motor planning and lower limb coordination.
Within six months, Sabrina will use a spoon to self-feed 50% of her meal without spilling, with moderate assistance, in 4 out of 5 meal opportunities, supporting adaptive and self-feeding skills.

Within four months, Sabrina will engage in parallel play with a peer for a duration of five minutes, with minimal verbal prompts in a structured play setting, supporting social participation and interaction skills.

Within six months, Sabrina will demonstrate the ability to follow a simple two-step direction related to familiar tasks with no more than 1 verbal cue in 4 out of 5 opportunities, enhancing cognitive processing and attention to task.

Within five months, Sabrina will participate in a sensory activity (e.g., playing with sand) for at least 10 minutes with no more than 2 verbal prompts, reducing sensory sensitivity and improving sensory processing skills.

Within six months, Sabrina will complete a simple art project using safety scissors to snip paper with assistance as needed, in 4 out of 5 opportunities, promoting fine motor dexterity and visual-motor integration.

Within four months, Sabrina will express wants or needs by using 3-word sentences during meal times with no more than 1 model cue in 4 out of 5 attempts, facilitating communication and social interaction skills.
